messages:
kate_cs: Quick heads-up — Emerald onboarding QBR prep. Noticed a sharp spend uptick last 72h, and they hit our soft alert twice. Need a quick runway scrub + plan for token guardrails before the Friday QBR. Sharing snapshot below.

kate_cs: usage snap: last 7d: $4.2k, last 24h: $1.6k, embeddings jobs = 68% of tokens, daily median = 420k tokens. Concern: onboarding bots running full dataset re-index.

billing-bot: Automated alert: Emerald (acct: emerald-inc) exceeded soft threshold $1500 in 24h (current: $1620). Alert sent to #cust-emerald and kate_cs.

aj_eng: @kate_cs can you paste the top routes? suspect `POST /embed/batch` has runaway retries. :eyes:

kate_cs: top routes: /embed/batch (74%), /chat (18%), /rerank (8%). I exported sample payloads to the drive — link: https://redwood.corp/drive/emerald-usage-3-21

eli_ops: Filed CS-488: temporary throttle + billing cap request. Ticket has proposed thresholds and rollback steps. Assigned to @sam_se.

sam_se: I’ll set a short-term cap and a canary rule. Proposed quick config:
```yaml
guardrail:
  max_tokens_per_day: 1500000
  soft_alert_usd: 1200
  hard_cap_usd: 2500
  notify_channels: ["#cust-emerald","#customer-success"]
```
I can push the cap now if everyone agrees.

aj_eng: thumbs-up from eng. Also will add a route-level retry limit to the embedding job (3 -> 1) and add idempotency keys to prevent replays.

kate_cs: Please push cap now. I’ll message Emerald CSM lead (anna@emerald.com) that we’ve applied a temporary throttle and will walk through a QBR spend plan.

eli_ops: Done — cap applied and CS-488 updated with timestamps and rollout note. :white_check_mark:

sam_se: FYI — quick forecast for Friday QBR: with cap + retry fix we project next 30d = $7.5k (vs current burn projection $12.4k). I’ll include a delta table for the deck.

kate_cs: Great — can someone own enablement material for the embed best practices? Need a 10-min slide and a 15-min ops runbook.

aj_eng: I can produce the ops runbook snippets (how to set idempotency, backoff).

sam_se: I’ll do the slide and include before/after cost curves + threshold config.

kate_cs: Also capture customer feedback: Emerald said embeddings quality dropped when they throttled batch size. They want a quick tradeoff doc (cost vs perf). Add to QBR agenda.

eli_ops: Noted — adding line item to QBR agenda and tagging product for follow-up.

kate_cs: Final ask: please add a persistent budget alert for Emerald so they get direct emails too (not only slack). I’ll coordinate consent.

sam_se: Will add email target and a weekly spend digest.

kate_cs: Thanks all — action items: sam: slides + email alerts; aj: runbook & retry patch; eli: ticket doc + confirm rollback; kate: customer comms + QBR agenda. Target: deck + runbook by Fri 9am. :rocket:
